newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER - AJAX'S OVERMARS SET TO JOIN ARSENAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - AJAX'S OVERMARS SET TO JOIN ARSENAL.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam winger Marc Overmars is set to join English premier league club Arsenal, the Dutch news agency ANP reported on Tuesday.
ANP quoted his business representative, Yvette Parlevliet, as saying she expected Overmars to sign a five-year contract today. An Ajax official was unable to comment on the report.
Overmars would become the second Dutch international at Arsenal, joining striker Dennis Bergkamp.
